title: Coalesce
description: Take the first non-empty value from a series of columns or lists.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: List of input columns or a single column containing lists.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of the output columns. This is required if multiple input columns are provided.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Take the first non-empty value from a series of columns. ## Migrated examples #### Coalescing 3 Columns ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - merge.coalesce: input: - Col1 - Col2 - Col3 output: Output Col where: Col2 = E ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | Col3 | | --- | --- | --- | | A | B | C | | D | E | F | | G | H | I |
##### Output Sample | Col1 | Col2 | Col3 | Output Col | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A | B | C | | | D | E | F | D | | G | H | I | |
